correctness.rationale: The Goldblatt--Hodkinson correspondence yields n+1 successors with pairwise incomparable future sets. In a strict partial order, transitivity places all those future sets inside the root's successor set and achronality excludes the offending successors themselves. Sperner's theorem gives the exact lower bound, and a central-layer construction attains it. The inverse-central-binomial asymptotic follows from the standard central-binomial estimate.
